༄༅/ /gsang thig skor gsum las/rdo rje gzhon nu phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshogs mchod phrin las bcud thig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gsang thig skor gsum las/ rdo rje gzhon nu phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshogs mchod phrin las bcud thig ces bya ba bzhugs so//

grub mchog kun gyi thugs dam lha// bdud 'dul khro bo chen po la// gus pas phyag byas tshogs mchod tshul// nyung ngur 'bri la dge legs stsol// lha 'di la tshogs mchod 'bul bar 'dod cing phrin las rgyas pa blos mi lcogs pa dag gis/ dpal gtor sman raka phyi mchod tshogs kyi rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams la/ gter gzhung gi bdag bskyed bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas mthar dbang len 'grub min gang bdes chog /de nas gtor ma bran la gtor 'bul phrin bcol bcas grub pa dang*/ tshogs rdzas chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ hūm̐: rang byung rig pa'i ye shes kyis: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis dngos 'dzin sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ las dbyings kyi ka pā lar: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥrnams kyis: bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dam tshig rdzas: kha dog dri ro nus par ldan: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra kā ma gu ṇa hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang: srung ma dam can 'khor dang bcas: srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi cho 'phrul las: 'dod yon mchod sprin bsam mi khyab: bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: skabs 'dir skong ba spro na/ hūm̐: ma bcos spros med de bzhin nyid dbyings las: bde chen lhun grub 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs pa: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang: yum mchog sgrol ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: rdo rje phur bu'i rig pa 'dzin rnams dang: khro bcu yab yum za byed gsod byed tshogs: sras mchog nyer gcig khro mo sgo ma bzhi: shwa na bdag nyid sa bdag skyes bu'i tshogs:

phur pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtshor bcas: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir skur bzhengs la: dam rdzas phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod dang: bdud rtsi rak+ta gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes: thugs dam gnyan po chos kyi dbyings su bskang: dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol zhing bshags: bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: sgo gsum longs spyod bcas pa srung ba dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas pa dang: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud pa dang: dgra bgegs thal bar brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: byad kha phur kha thams cad zlog tu gsol: bkra shis bde legs 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: tshar grangs lta bu shin tu bsdu skabs skong ba 'di ma byas kyang chog /bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med spyod pas dam 'gal ba: tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang zhing bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe a: bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra dang bgegs: rnam thar gsum gyi e dbyings su: ye shes phur pa'i mtshon gyis bsgral: lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabs: ma traṃ ru dra mā ra ya māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: gal te yun thung ngus tshar grangs gsag dgos pa byung na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: mchod pa rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shig: nyams chag rgya mtsho ma lus bshags: thugs dam rgya mtsho ma lus bskang: dngos grub rgya mtsho bstsal du gsol: phrin las rgya mtsho ma lus sgrubs: zhes pa la grangs gzung ngo*// de nas brda'i 'bul len bcas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan dam tshig can: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' lung bzhin:

bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: des tshogs kyi phrin las grub cing*/ rjes mchod bstod ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: ma hā pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du: byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba: sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i: phur pa phrin las lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis: bde chen gsang ba'i mkha' klong nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blang*/ hūm̐: snang srid phur bu'i dkyil 'khor rnams: thugs kyi thig le chen por thim: dpal chen po yi dbyings nyid las: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal: zhes bsdu ldang bya/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wā nāṃ/ zhes mgron thabs 'jig rten pa gshegs/ hūm̐: mi gnas ye shes dkyil 'khor du: sku gsung thugs su lhun grub nas: rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang thob: 'gro ba kun gyi dpal du shog: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang byin rlabs kun gyi bdag: srid pa'i phur bu dngos grub kun gyi gter: ma mo mkha' 'gro myur mgyogs phrin las can: phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shog: ces bsngo smon dang shis pa brjod pas dge legs su bya'o// dpal chen dgyes pa'i nyi 'od kyis// lha min mun tshogs rab bsal nas// gnas skabs mthar thug grub gnyis kyi// dge mtshan rgyas pa'i dpal du shog /ces pa'ang nye bar gnas pa karma nor 'phel nas don du gnyer ba'i ngor/ 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa rtsal gyis gter gzhung rnams kyi dgongs pa bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel//
